title: Pure Yubel
summary: Pure Yubel destruction and burn control strategy, centered on GX's iconic 0 ATK Fiend entity that turns all incoming battle damage back onto the attacker. The deck actively destroys its own Yubel forms to climb through Terror Incarnate into The Ultimate Nightmare, rewrites opponent monster effects, and fuses into the indestructible Loving Defender Forever.

summary.title: Starters
points: Samsara D Lotus tributes itself from field as a Quick Effect to Special Summon any Yubel monster directly from your Deck, and rewrites an opponent's monster effect into destroying a Yubel monster you control.

Nightmare Throne searches any Fiend monster with 0 ATK and 0 DEF (such as Spirit of Yubel, Samsara D Lotus, or Yubel) on activation, and adds or Special Summons a Yubel monster with 1 Level higher or lower whenever a face-up Yubel leaves the field by card effect.

Nightmare Pain destroys 1 DARK monster in your hand or face-up field to search any Yubel card from your Deck, forces the opponent to attack Yubel monsters, and reflects all battle damage to the opponent.

Spirit of Yubel Special Summons itself from hand when an attack is declared, adds or Sets a Yubel Spell/Trap directly from your Deck on summon, and cannot be destroyed by battle while reflecting damage.
Gruesome Grave Squirmer Special Summons itself next to a Fiend, destroys a Yubel monster you control to trigger its floating evolution, and banishes itself from GY to revive a 0 ATK/0 DEF Fiend.

summary.title: Opening: Samsara D Lotus + Nightmare Throne
steps: Activate Nightmare Throne to add Spirit of Yubel (or Samsara D Lotus) from your Deck to your hand.
Normal Summon Samsara D Lotus and activate its effect, tributing itself to Special Summon Spirit of Yubel from your Deck.
Spirit of Yubel triggers on summon, adding Nightmare Pain from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Nightmare Pain; destroy Spirit of Yubel to search Eternal Favorite (or Mature Chronicle).
Spirit of Yubel triggers upon being destroyed, Special Summoning the original Yubel from your hand, Deck, or GY.
Contact Fuse Phantom of Yubel by shuffling Spirit of Yubel and Yubel from your field and GY into the Deck.
During the End Phase, Samsara D Lotus revives itself from the GY to your field.

summary.title: The Yubel Evolutions & Effect Rewriting
points: Yubel cannot be destroyed by battle, inflicts damage to the attacking opponent equal to their monster's ATK, and Special Summons Yubel - Terror Incarnate when destroyed by card effect.
Yubel - Terror Incarnate destroys all other monsters on the field during your End Phase, and Special Summons Yubel - The Ultimate Nightmare when it leaves the field.
Yubel - The Ultimate Nightmare destroys any monster it battles at the end of the Damage Step and inflicts damage equal to its ATK to the opponent.

Phantom of Yubel is a Contact Fusion that can be summoned by shuffling Yubel and a 0 ATK/DEF Fiend from hand, field, or GY into the Deck, and as a Quick Effect changes an opponent monster's activated effect into destroying 1 Yubel monster you control.
Unchained Soul of Rage uses an opponent's Special Summoned monster on their turn to Link Summon into S:P Little Knight.

summary.title: Fusion Bosses & Spells
points: Yubel - The Loving Defender Forever is Fusion Summoned using 1 Yubel monster and 1+ Effect Monsters on the field; it cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, banishes all monsters it battles without damage calculation, and burns for 500 damage per banished monster.
Eternal Favorite revives a Yubel monster from GY once per turn, or discards 1 card to Fusion Summon using monsters from either player's field (including Yubel).
Mature Chronicle accumulates counters whenever a Yubel monster is Special Summoned, spending counters to revive, search Super Polymerization, or destroy cards.
Super Polymerization clears the opponent's entire board unanswerably by fusing their monsters into Yubel - The Loving Defender Forever.
